messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [Sev2] fringe-07 reported repeated OOMs -> 12 container restarts in 8m. alert: https://monitoring.redwood.example/alerts/1234
lia: i'm on it, grabbing logs + metrics
miguel: taking lead, ping me with findings @lia
sara: seeing CUDA driver errors right before OOMs, extracting stack traces now
miguel: logs:
```
[2026-03-17T02:12:05Z] cudaErrorIllegalAddress: kernel 0x7f... at kv_alloc.cpp:412
[2026-03-17T02:12:06Z] oom-killer invoked: task=node-agent pid=4321
```
oncall-bot: scheduled node restart for fringe-07 (ETA ~2m)
lia: restarting runtime on fringe-07 now
miguel: resident memory for redwood-runtime has been trending up ~3% daily for last 36h, KV slab fragmentation suspected. metric: https://monitoring.redwood.example/d/kv/kv-frag?panel=3
sara: can we disable paged-attention on that pool as a quick mitigation?
tim: yes — set REDWOOD_PAGED_ATTENTION=0 for the pool and bounce runtime. will trade some latency for memory headroom
miguel: bumping eviction: `kv.evict.threshold=0.6` and enable compaction: `kv.compact=true` on fringe-07, applying now
lia: compaction job started, currently reclaimed ~12% of resident
miguel: runtime restarted, containers came back healthy, no new OOMs in last 90s
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: update: OOMs ceased, node stabilized, customer errors reduced ~82%
lia: next actions: rollout compaction across pool, add a regression alert for KV resident growth, schedule deeper leak debug with alloc team
sara: opening ticket with logs + gdb snippets, assigning to @alloc-team and CC'ing CS to notify impacted tenants
tim: noted, i'll do a config patch for the pool and coordinate the canary rollout
miguel: handing off remaining watch to @miguel-2 in 30m, leaving monitoring playbook links in the ticket :thumbsup:
